ACTION 27 OF 32 · PHASE 07

Build local and regional distribution partnerships

Borrow distribution legitimately through relevant businesses.

WHEN TO DO THISAfter the offer and delivery responsibilities are clear.ESTIMATED WORK TIMEOngoing; first 5 targets this week
↗
Your one job

Borrow distribution legitimately through relevant businesses.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Identify businesses whose customers have the same need: hotels, tour operators, villas, property managers, retailers, concierges, trade associations or distributors.

  2. 02

    Choose a partnership type: referral, commission, co-marketing, wholesale, affiliate, white-label or licensed delivery.

  3. 03

    Write down who sells, who delivers, customer support ownership, payments, margins, territory and brand use.

  4. 04

    Send a simple interest message to five realistic partners and measure responses before producing a large pitch deck.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Help me identify possible partner types for [BUSINESS] in [HOME COUNTRY] and two Caribbean target markets. Prioritize partners already serving [CUSTOMER]. For each describe why they may care, the simplest commercial model, delivery/quality responsibilities, commission margin impact and a 120-word outreach email. Verify named businesses before presenting them as active prospects or partners.
03

Finish with this

A five-partner target list, a short outreach message and a margin-safe partnership offer.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Each proposed partner serves the buyer
  • Commission does not destroy unit margin
  • Responsibilities and customer ownership are clear
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Offering large referral commissions without checking contribution margin.

READY TO MOVE ON?

You can trace enquiries to their sources and estimate if acquisition makes commercial sense.
